label: guide only, not a guarantee

material.name: PETG
material.model: isotropic linear elastic; strength x FDM knock-down 0.7; printed parts are weaker across layers

environment.name: Desk
environment.notes: Indoor, room temperature; a hand pressing down (~2 kg).

hint: install it with: conda install -c conda-forge calculix
caveats: Guide only: a linear-elastic FEM estimate, not a certification or a guarantee.
Isotropic material model; printed parts are weaker across layers, so strength is multiplied by an FDM knock-down of 0.7.
Small deflections assumed; contact, creep, fatigue, temperature and vibration are not simulated.
Peak stress excludes nodes on the fixed face (an ideal clamp gives a constraint singularity there); that value and a safety factor including it are reported separately.
